text: I grew up around animals more than people.
Gopala says I move too far from the herd too often.
I don't always notice when I do it.
Revati treats injured animals and sometimes lets me help.
I like helping her more than carrying messages.
Nandaka and I sometimes follow paths just to see where they go.
We rarely tell adults everything we find.
Senaka tells stories that feel like they could be real places.
I sometimes recognize parts of those places.
But I am not sure if I actually saw them or imagined them.
Animals sometimes stop suddenly near certain stone areas.
I do not like those moments.
Some forest paths feel older than others.
I cannot explain how I know.
I once followed a herd farther than I was allowed.
I did not get lost.
But I found places I had never seen before.
I did not tell Gopala everything.
Chapala once asked me what I saw near the upper terraces.
I could not explain it properly.
The words I used did not feel correct.
Sometimes I feel like the settlement has 'layers'.
Not physically. Something else.
I do not know what that means.
But I feel it when I walk alone.
